subject: GOL-any-project
text: Proposal (2026-10-06, after 5878314): the plugin now ships a fourth server, graph-snapshot. It installs from the same release tag and reads the same project root, and tests/test_plugin.py checks both. acceptance/test_any_project.py::test_the_plugin_installs_the_release_of_its_own_version pins the server set to three, so CTR-runs-in-any-project reads refuted (RUN-0118, 2/3), on that assertion alone. If you accept a fourth server, the one-line change is line 31: add "graph-snapshot" to the expected set. The agent has not edited it; acceptance/ is your goal set.
